comment: Extrude of a sketch on a cylinder's side with Join and Cut and their bodies (mitcad#1908, GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#362), as Extrude's automatic operation sends them: a Join with the cylinder as its participant and the dormant cut targets the panel keeps (initialize_on_cut), a Cut with its cut_scope and no participants. Component1 (C1, O1): a cylinder of diameter 300 and height 129 (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2, F2.b0): 22500 pi 129.

Sketch2 (F3) on the cylinder's side in its developed coordinates, its origin at z = 0 on the +X side: a 60 x 30 rectangle from (-100, 40) (c1..c4) and a circle of diameter 40 about (40, 60) (c9), A = 1800 + 400 pi on the face.
Both raised 10 out of the cylinder as a Join with the cylinder as its participant and the panel's dormant cut targets (the reported refusal: 'no ... cut scope'): A 10 (1 + 10 / 300) more, one body.
The same profiles sunk 5 into the cylinder as a Cut with its cut targets (all of the context's, no participants): A 5 (1 - 5 / 300) less.
Thin walls do not apply to such an extrusion: refused in words, and taken back.

expect.error_contains: an extrusion of a sketch on a curved face has no thin walls
